blocks.text: In the Masoretic arrangement, Jeremiah 47 appears within chapters 46–51, a collection of oracles concerning nations. The book as received combines several forms of material, including poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, restoration collections, and this nation-oracle collection. Its long compositional and textual history remains debated. An ancient Greek edition differs markedly from the Masoretic form: it is shorter and places the nation oracles earlier in a different order. This means Jeremiah 47 can be read as part of the book’s nation-oracle collection, while the precise history of the book’s differing ancient forms should be held with appropriate caution.
